ValidationRule.description: VR-OPP-11: Deal Type must be set before entering the Quote stage. Required for Booking Bucket derivation and quota attribution.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( OR( ISPICKVAL(StageName, '3-Quote'), ISPICKVAL(StageName, '4-Negotiate'), ISPICKVAL(StageName, '5-Won') ), NOT(ISCHANGED(StageName)), ISPICKVAL(Deal_Type__c, '') )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Deal Type is required from Quote stage onwards. Select the deal classification before advancing.
